svg.aria-label: B2-F02 — usable extent collapses as storage grows, and the rule stops certifying
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart of the widest admissible run in log-10 cycles at five storage strengths. The storage-free control reaches 4.100 cycles and C_D = 100 reaches 1.200, both past the dashed rule at 1.0 cycle that marks the minimum extent the rule requires, and both are certified. C_D = 1000 reaches only 0.100 cycles, and C_D = 3000 and C_D = 10000 reach 0.000 and 0.000: at those two levels no point in the record is simultaneously flat enough and clear of the storage identity, so there is no admissible run at all. The collapse is abrupt rather than gradual between 100 and 1000.
